queries.inventory: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON(provider,provider_event_id) id,provider,provider_event_id,game_status,season,week,home_provider_team_id,away_provider_team_id,home_team_name,away_team_name,home_score,away_score,captured_at,kickoff_at,payload_hash,COALESCE(payload#>>'{game,seasonType}',payload->>'seasonType') AS season_phase,COALESCE(payload#>>'{game,homeClassification}',payload->>'homeClassification') AS home_class,COALESCE(payload#>>'{game,awayClassification}',payload->>'awayClassification') AS away_class FROM ncaaf_game_evidence WHERE season=2026 ORDER BY provider,provider_event_id,captured_at DESC,id DESC), candidates AS (SELECT g.*,r.id AS result_id,r.home_score AS result_home_score,r.away_score AS result_away_score,r.grading_source,r.graded_at,r.updated_at AS result_updated_at,r.raw_result_json FROM games g LEFT JOIN game_results r ON r.game_id=g.id WHERE g.sport='NCAAF' AND g.status='final' AND (r.id IS NULL OR g.home_score IS DISTINCT FROM r.home_score OR g.away_score IS DISTINCT FROM r.away_score)) SELECT c.id,c.game_date,c.starts_at,c.home_team_id,c.away_team_id,c.home_team_name,c.away_team_name,c.home_score,c.away_score,c.updated_at AS game_updated_at,c.result_id,c.result_home_score,c.result_away_score,c.grading_source,c.graded_at,c.result_updated_at,md5(COALESCE(c.raw_result_json::text,'null')) AS result_raw_md5,COALESCE(c.raw_result_json->'tbmNcaafIntegrity'->>'schemaVersion','') AS integrity_proof, e.id AS espn_evidence_id,e.game_status AS espn_status,e.home_score AS espn_home_score,e.away_score AS espn_away_score,e.home_provider_team_id AS espn_home_id,e.away_provider_team_id AS espn_away_id,e.kickoff_at AS espn_kickoff,e.captured_at AS espn_captured_at,e.payload_hash AS espn_payload_hash, f.id AS cfbd_evidence_id,f.provider_event_id AS cfbd_event_id,f.game_status AS cfbd_status,f.home_score AS cfbd_home_score,f.away_score AS cfbd_away_score,f.home_provider_team_id AS cfbd_home_id,f.away_provider_team_id AS cfbd_away_id,f.kickoff_at AS cfbd_kickoff,f.captured_at AS cfbd_captured_at,f.payload_hash AS cfbd_payload_hash,f.season_phase,f.week,f.home_class,f.away_class FROM candidates c LEFT JOIN latest e ON e.provider='espn' AND e.provider_event_id=c.id LEFT JOIN latest f ON f.provider='college_football_data' AND f.provider_event_id=replace(c.id,'NCAAF-','') ORDER BY c.game_date,c.id
queries.summary: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON(provider,provider_event_id) provider,provider_event_id,season,game_status,kickoff_at,home_provider_team_id,away_provider_team_id,home_score,away_score,COALESCE(payload#>>'{game,seasonType}',payload->>'seasonType') AS phase,COALESCE(payload#>>'{game,homeClassification}',payload->>'homeClassification') AS hc,COALESCE(payload#>>'{game,awayClassification}',payload->>'awayClassification') AS ac FROM ncaaf_game_evidence WHERE season=2026 ORDER BY provider,provider_event_id,captured_at DESC,id DESC), fixtures AS (SELECT g.*,r.id AS result_id,r.home_score AS rh,r.away_score AS ra FROM games g LEFT JOIN game_results r ON r.game_id=g.id WHERE g.sport='NCAAF'), cf AS (SELECT l.*,g.id AS game_id,g.home_team_id,g.away_team_id FROM latest l LEFT JOIN games g ON g.sport='NCAAF' AND g.id='NCAAF-'||l.provider_event_id WHERE provider='college_football_data' AND game_status='final' AND kickoff_at<current_timestamp AND phase='regular' AND hc='fbs' AND ac='fbs'), training AS (SELECT season,count(*)::int AS n FROM ncaaf_historical_training_rows WHERE artifact_key='ncaaf-v4-training-foundation-v2' GROUP BY season) SELECT current_timestamp AS audited_at,(SELECT jsonb_build_object('fixtures',count(*),'finals',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='final'),'missing_results',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='final' AND result_id IS NULL),'score_disagreements',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='final' AND result_id IS NOT NULL AND (home_score IS DISTINCT FROM rh OR away_score IS DISTINCT FROM ra)),'zero_zero_finals',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='final' AND home_score=0 AND away_score=0),'missing_canonical_identity',count(*) FILTER(WHERE home_team_id IS NULL OR away_team_id IS NULL OR starts_at IS NULL)) FROM fixtures) AS game_summary,(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT home_team_id,away_team_id,game_date FROM fixtures GROUP BY home_team_id,away_team_id,game_date HAVING count(*)>1) d) AS duplicate_fixture_groups,(SELECT jsonb_build_object('cfbd_declared_fbs_regular_completed',count(*),'missing_fixture_ids',count(*) FILTER(WHERE game_id IS NULL),'team_id_mismatches',count(*) FILTER(WHERE game_id IS NOT NULL AND (home_provider_team_id IS DISTINCT FROM home_team_id OR away_provider_team_id IS DISTINCT FROM away_team_id))) FROM cf) AS bounded_coverage,(SELECT jsonb_agg(training ORDER BY season) FROM training) AS frozen_rows,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('provider',provider,'phase',phase,'status',game_status,'count',n)) FROM (SELECT provider,phase,game_status,count(*)::int AS n FROM latest GROUP BY provider,phase,game_status) x) AS source_inventory
